user.title: TV Camera Overlay
user.description: Shows a live camera, photo, or message on top of whatever's playing on an Android TV running the companion camera-overlay app, without switching away from it. Which TV, camera, and position are picked per service call — nothing to configure here.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured — only a single instance is needed.

show.name: Show TV overlay
show.description: Shows a live camera, a video, a photo, a title, and/or a message on top of whatever's already playing on the target TV — without switching away from it. Combine any of camera_entity/video_url/image_url/title/message; at least one is required. video_url takes priority over camera_entity, which takes priority over image_url, for the main visual; title/message are always independently combinable with any of them.

camera_entity.name: Camera
camera_entity.description: A Home Assistant camera entity to show as live video.

video_url.name: Video URL
video_url.description: A direct video stream to play instead of (or without) a Home Assistant camera entity — HLS, plain HTTP(S), RTSP (a local-network camera's own feed or an internet-exposed one), or a youtube.com/youtu.be link. Bypasses Home Assistant entirely; takes priority over camera_entity if both are set.

image_url.name: Photo URL
image_url.description: A direct photo URL to show instead of live video (ignored if camera_entity is also set). Works with any image URL, including a camera's own snapshot/camera_proxy URL.

image_path.name: Photo file path
image_path.description: A local file on this Home Assistant's own disk to show as a photo instead of a URL — ignored if image_url is also set. Only files under the config's www/ folder work (that's the one folder HA serves publicly); give the path as /config/www/... or just www/....

title.name: Title
title.description: A heading shown above the message — combinable with either visual, or on its own.

message.name: Message
message.description: Text shown below the title — combinable with either visual, or on its own.

icon_url.name: Icon URL
icon_url.description: A small inline icon shown first in the title/message block (left of it with a horizontal text_layout, above it with vertical) — not a photo box. Animated WebP/GIF keep playing, e.g. an animated weather icon next to "22°C".

icon_size.name: Icon size
icon_size.description: Square size of the icon_url icon, in dp.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Seconds before the overlay auto-hides itself. 0 means it stays until the hide action is called.

position.name: Position
position.description: Where on screen the overlay appears.

size.name: Size
size.description: How big the video/photo box is. Only affects a video or photo — a message-only overlay is always sized to its text.

sound_url.name: Alert sound URL
sound_url.description: A direct audio URL to play once as an alert sound, independent of the visual overlay — plays even on a repeated trigger for content that's already showing. Takes priority over chime's bundled default if both are set.

chime.name: Play chime
chime.description: Play a bundled default two-tone doorbell chime once, if sound_url isn't set.

loading_opacity.name: Loading background opacity
loading_opacity.description: How solid the placeholder background looks while a video/photo is still loading, before it appears (0 = fully see-through, 100 = solid black). A small loading spinner shows on top of it either way.

text_position.name: Title/message position
text_position.description: Where the title/message block sits relative to a video or photo — on top of it (along its bottom edge) or as a separate strip directly underneath it. Only matters when there's also a video or photo; title/message alone always renders as its own block either way.

text_layout.name: Title/message line layout
text_layout.description: Whether the title and message sit stacked (each on its own line) or side by side on one line — e.g. a weather emoji as the title next to a short "22°C" message, both on one row in a small permanent widget.

text_background_opacity.name: Title/message background opacity
text_background_opacity.description: How solid the title/message's own background strip is (0 = fully see-through, 100 = solid black).

rounded_corners.name: Rounded corners
rounded_corners.description: Whether the video/photo box and the title/message background have rounded corners.

ok_webhook_id.name: OK button webhook
ok_webhook_id.description: Makes this overlay interactive: while it's showing, it takes remote-control focus away from whatever's underneath, and pressing OK/Enter calls this Home Assistant webhook (create one under Settings > Automations > Webhook trigger, and put its ID here) — use it for things like "press OK to unlock the door". BACK dismisses without calling it. Leave empty for a normal, non-interactive overlay that never takes focus.

ok_response_message.name: OK confirmation message
ok_response_message.description: Ignored unless ok_webhook_id is also set. Replaces the overlay with this brief confirmation text (e.g. "Door opened") right after OK is pressed and the webhook fires, instead of it just vanishing silently. Combinable with ok_response_image_url/ok_response_image_path. Auto-hides itself a few seconds later.

ok_response_image_url.name: OK confirmation photo URL
ok_response_image_url.description: Ignored unless ok_webhook_id is also set. A photo URL shown alongside (or instead of) ok_response_message in that same brief confirmation.

ok_response_image_path.name: OK confirmation photo file path
ok_response_image_path.description: Same as ok_response_image_url, but a local file path under this Home Assistant's own config/www/ folder instead of a URL — ignored if ok_response_image_url is also set.

muted.name: Muted
muted.description: Whether the video/camera's own audio track plays or is silenced. Only relevant with camera_entity/video_url — a photo-only or message-only overlay has no audio either way.

slot.name: Slot
slot.description: A freeform name for which independent overlay this targets. A new call for the same slot replaces only that slot's own overlay; a different slot coexists completely independently — e.g. a permanent "weather" widget in one corner and a separate "temperature" one elsewhere, both up at once alongside the usual camera-stream/message triggers (set duration to 0 to keep a widget up permanently, until explicitly hidden). Leave empty for the normal behavior: any camera/video/photo uses one shared slot, a title/message-only call uses a separate shared slot, so a live stream and a plain notification already coexist without needing this.

margin.name: Edge margin
margin.description: Distance in dp from the screen edge(s) for a non-center position. Lower it (e.g. to 0-2) to hug the very edge — useful for a small permanent status-style widget (weather, temperature, ...) that should sit right at the screen's limit rather than visibly inset from it. Ignored for a center position.

hide.name: Hide TV overlay
hide.description: Immediately hides the overlay on the target TV, regardless of any duration set when it was shown. Without slot, hides everything currently showing, in every slot.

slot.name: Slot
slot.description: Hide only this named slot (see the slot field on the show action), leaving every other slot's overlay untouched. Leave empty to hide everything.

test.name: Test TV overlay
test.description: Shows a short centered confirmation message with a chime on the target TV, auto-hiding itself after a few seconds — a real end-to-end check that the whole chain (this integration -> adb -> the companion Android app) is working, visible on the TV itself, no fields to fill in.
